treatment_summary.value: Percutaneous transluminal angioplasty, then lower leg amputation; continued anticoagulation (low-molecular-weight heparin); methylprednisolone and oral cyclophosphamide 2 mg/kg (resolution of inflammation, purpura, leukopenia), then rituximab 2 × 1000 mg IV with sustained remission. Table 1 therapy: methotrexate, IgRT, cyclophosphamide, rituximab.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Diagnostic whole-exome sequencing (in silico IEI gene panel) on the mother's DNA identified the heterozygous TNFAIP3 c.608T > G p.(Leu203Arg) variant; functional studies (reduced A20 expression, NF-κB/STAT1/mTOR activation).

treatment_summary.value: High-dose oral dexamethasone for ITP (platelet normalization); infliximab (complete resolution); azithromycin maintenance for recurrent upper respiratory tract infections; endoscopic sinus surgery; on relapse adalimumab (insufficient response), then rituximab; immunoglobulin replacement therapy; receiving TNF blockers at the time of the later studies. Table 1 therapy: anakinra, adalimumab, infliximab, golimumab, IgRT, rituximab.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Segregation analysis by Sanger sequencing after WES in the mother identified the heterozygous TNFAIP3 c.608T > G p.(Leu203Arg) variant; functional studies (reduced A20 expression, NF-κB/STAT1/mTOR activation).

functional_evidence_statement.value: Immunoblot of patient PBMCs showed reduced A20 expression before and after TNFα stimulation (A20/actin after TNFα: P1 0.205, P2 0.218 vs mean HC 0.802); in HEK293T overexpression, mutant A20 expression was reduced (A20/actin 0.28 vs 1.18 wild-type) with increased TRAF6 (0.92 vs 0.57) and phosphorylated IκBα (0.18 vs 0.13) after TNFα; patient PBMCs showed increased phosphorylation of p65 NF-κB, IκBα, STAT1 (not STAT3), mTOR and p70S6K, and elevated TNFα and IL-1β production after LPS/Poly I:C stimulation, abrogated by p38 inhibition but not by tofacitinib.
